# pve_vm_suspend (Action)

Suspends a QEMU VM (`POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status/suspend`). The action waits for the suspend task to finish. With `todisk` the VM is suspended to disk and resumes on the next start.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Suspend VM 100 to disk; it resumes on the next start.
action "pve_vm_suspend" "suspend_vm" {
  config {
    node         = "pve1"
    vmid         = 100
    todisk       = true
    statestorage = "local-lvm"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node running the VM.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM identifier. Must be between 100 and 999999999.

### Optional

- `statestorage` (String) The storage holding the VM state.
- `todisk` (Boolean) If set, suspends the VM to disk; it will be resumed on the next VM start.
